title: Honest question about helping me playtest an AI generated game
author: drhoads
selftext:
I started a project just for fun for a bunch of classic games and retro operating systems.

I was making it just for me (using AI) and I thought it was really a lot of fun!  

I posted in a few retro computing and gaming forums and got flamed to hell for AI slop.  

I know I should not be offended but I put a lot of work into it and genuinely thought it is fun/funny and could use some feedback to make it even better.  There are a lot of old operating systems that I didn’t use or was so long ago that some feedback would be really helpful.

How in the hell do you ask for feedback outside of this community?  It was downright hostile and I am just like “I think this is fun, do you want to play it and let me know what you think” and it was like I am the most horrible person in the world! lol.  

Anyway, I am thankful for this group at least.  That being said.  I made this literally just for me and just for fun, but it came out so well that I think others may enjoy it!  if you like old operating systems would you like to check it out and give me feedback/bugs/suggestion, etc?

If this is STILL not the right place to post this, I will delete this post.  

thank you for anyone who wants to try it out! 😀

Enjoy! 

[https://dr-hoads.itch.io/dr-hoads-game-parlor](https://dr-hoads.itch.io/dr-hoads-game-parlor)

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: can't these be found more polish somewhere else for free and mobile only?

replies.author: drhoads
replies.body: Yep! Lol.  I just liked having them in a compilation with the retro operating systems.  It is more about the operating systems WITH the games. It could be that the only target audience is myself.  🤣

replies.author: Ok-Investment4414
replies.body: all things factored in still doubt it was just curious

replies.author: drhoads
replies.body: ok, well thanks for the feedback.  I put a lot of effort into the OSes, I will spend some time polishing the games.
